# Meegle

> > Meegle is a free visual workflow and project management tool that combines task automation, multi-view visibility, and cross-functional collaboration for product, game, agile, and software development teams.

Meegle offers a comprehensive platform for visual project management with workflow automation capabilities. The tool serves diverse industries including game development, autonomous driving R&D, and product management, trusted by companies like Momenta, Skylink Studio, and DEEPROUTE.Ai.

## Key Topics

- Visual Workflow Management
- Project Management
- Workflow Automation
- Task Management
- Team Collaboration
- Game Development
- Agile Development
- Multi-View Visibility
- Resource Allocation
- Workflow Visualization
- Integration & Connectivity
- Analytics & Dashboards
- Cross-functional Teams
- Autonomous Driving
- ASPICE Compliance
